title: Mixed Event — Insatiable Pale Color — Episode7 If You Want Recognition

meta.Event Outline: While Kanade and the others embrace Nightcord at 25:00's rising popularity, Ena's illustration account remains stagnant. Ena then sets her sights on an art competition...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I am. I'm sorry for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And thank you for the song, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're welcome. I was hoping you'd hear it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade made that song just for you, Ena. She just knocked the melody and stuff out crazy fast by getting into the zone or something!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I needed her to hear it as soon as possible so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your songs really are nice and gentle...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It felt so warm and made my heart sink a little, but I immediately got that you wanted to get those feelings across...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to draw something for this song, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to see how you visualize it and what you'll make...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I... I want to draw too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter how much I draw, no one recognizes my art. It didn't feel like I was doing anything at all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I thought that my art was being appreciated since they were a part of these songs but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In the end, no one acknowledges my art unless it has music attached to it. No one cares unless I say that I'm the artist for N25...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My father even told me a while back that I don't have any talent...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was so frustrated by that and I kept on drawing to prove him wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's just like he said. I really don't have any talent. I really won't get any recognition...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And if that's the case, then there's no point in me drawing anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I hate myself for thinking that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I hate the part of me that can't draw unless they get some sort of attention...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that you don't have any talent, Ena, but I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's not what this is! Your dad or these others may not acknowledge your art, but at the very least, I like what you draw.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I don't believe that you're the kind of person that needs recognition in order to draw, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's why I was drawn to your art.
That's why I asked you to join N25...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you need acknowledgement from someone, then I'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N25 needs you, Ena. It needs your art.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're the ones that really appreciate you as an artist!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is there something wrong with wanting to be appreciated?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you hate the part of you that wants attention?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If no one acknowledges or recognizes you now, just keep drawing until someone does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have to keep creating what we do anyway so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why do you make it sound so easy?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh...
My head was a complete mess, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Wow, my room's a mess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd like to draw now, but cleaning up might have to come first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And getting my paint cleaned and sorted is gonna be such a pain. Everything else is all over the place too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I can start by getting them back on the shelf and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This is... My old sketch book?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I haven't seen this in ages. It's from back in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, I used to be terrible. I guess I just learned to wet wash, but the paper is all bent out of shape now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And this was when I decided to become an artist...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But now... I'm different from that girl with her head in the clouds.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, little me... Is it really okay for me to keep drawing like this?
